At this point there are about 10000 optical prescriptions available in the Optical Bench.
(Some are only available if you know the exact patent and example that you desire.) In the future you will be able to filter those optical prescriptions on this page using various criteria.
For the time being the table below is only populated with more than 1280 optical prescriptions for known lenses.
Naturally there is no guarantee that a production lens followed the patent optical prescription precisely.
And in some cases the patent optical prescription below doesn't line up perfectly with the production lens.
The table is resizable and sortable by clicking on the column headers.
If you click on an item that lens will open the Optical Bench in a separate window/tab.
